thread:
Ravi K: FYI invoice-preview shows a persistent delta for tenants matching corp-x after we toggled the fallback priority yesterday.
Ellen C: link?
Ravi K: https://console/redwood/preview/invoices?filter=corp-x
Ravi K: rough numbers from preview: +22,702 tokens across 5 tenants in last 3h (~$89). small but reproducible.
Tom H: any routing changes around that window?
Ravi K: we flipped canary routing to "latency-first" at 01:45 UTC; router started preferring local-quantized variants; suspect fallback wiring.
Marta (billing): are these real invoice changes or preview artifacts?
Ravi K: likely preview-only if we backfill. the ingestion enrichment is losing the billing_tag on fallback events.
Tom H: quick check in router code shows our fallback short-path constructs payload with only model_id & node_id, intentionally omitting billing_tag to avoid coupling.
Ellen C: enrichment consumer expects billing_tag present. when missing we create new attribution via session_fingerprint which scatters charges.
Ravi K: concrete affected set: corp-x-dev1..dev5, token_delta: 22,702, estimated cost delta: $89.74.
ingest-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-02T04:12:00Z fallback-tag-missing spike: 520/min for shard canary-07
Tom H: propose options:
1) small hotfix: include billing_tag in fallback payload (fast)
2) enrichment: tolerate missing billing_tag and synthesize from request headers (bigger change)
3) backfill: corrective enrichment for the window (mitigates preview)
Marta (billing): preference is 1+3 if low risk. finance prefers no manual adjustments.
Ellen C: if we include billing_tag in fallback we need a contract test so router changes won't regress this again.
Tom H: I'll open a PR to add billing_tag to fallback payload and add a unit test; canary deploy in 20m.
Ravi K: backfill SQL sketch for later:
```
WITH derived AS (
  SELECT id, max(billing_tag) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id) AS billing_tag
  FROM events
  WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-01 22:00:00' AND '2026-03-02 05:00:00' AND billing_tag IS NULL
)
UPDATE events
SET billing_tag = derived.billing_tag
FROM derived
WHERE events.id = derived.id;
```
Marta (billing): include CSV with columns: tenant, original_tag, corrected_tag, tokens_delta, amount_delta, reason
Ellen C: I'll add a dashboard rule: alert when >0.2% events within 1h for a tenant are missing billing_tag, and add an invoice-preview guard for tenant token deltas >0.4%
Tom H: canary deployed to canary-07 at 04:30 UTC. monitoring now.
ingest-bot: [RESOLVE] 2026-03-02T05:02:13Z router-fallback-billing_tag restored on canary-07
Ravi K: patch looked clean. running targeted backfill now; ETA 45m.
Marta (billing): finance, please hold on finalize. I'll review CSV once backfill completes.
Ellen C: ticket: INF-1392 add schema contract test between router and enrichment; assign Tom + QA.
Ravi K: thanks everyone, will post backfill summary + CSV in this thread when done :thumbsup:
